newsitem.title: EU: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY.
newsitem.headline: REUTER EUROPEAN COURT OF JUSTICE DIARY.

text.p: SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment C-167/95 Linthorst, Pouwels en Scheres: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 9 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Providing a service. Place where provided. Services provided by a vet. Vet established in one member state and practising in another. - Opinion C-90/94 Haahr Petroleum: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 9 to 12, 13, 84 and 95 of EC treaty. National regulation on taxes for the use of public and private trade ports applying to national and imported products. Supplementary tax of 40% on imported goods only. - Opinion joined cases C-114/95, C-115/95 Texaco: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 9 to 13, 18 to 29, 86, 90 and 96. Interpretation of Council regulation 4055/86 of December 22, 1986, applying the principle of freedom to provide a service to maritime transports between member states and between member and third party states and of Council regulation 4056/86 of December 22, 1986, setting down application measures for articles 85 and 86 of the maritime transport treaty. Interpretation of agreements on EU-Sweden and EU-Norway free trade. National regulation on taxes for the use of public and private trade ports applying to national and imported products. Supplementary tax of 40% on imported goods only. - Opinion C-242/95 GT-Link: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of articles 9 to 13, 74 to 84 and 95 of EC treaty. Interpretation of articles 35 to 37 of M use of public and private trade ports applying to national and imported products. Supplementary tax of 40% on imported goods only. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 86 and 90, paragraph 2. Collection by a public company of a national tax on the use of public trade ports applying to national and imported products. Supplementary tax of 40% on imported goods only. Exemption from tax for the vessels of the company concerned and affiliated vessels. National taxes incompatible with EU law. Undue repetition. - Opinion C-330/95 Goldsmiths: taxation. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of article 11, part C, point 1 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Reduction in case of partial non-payment. Power of a member state to provide for a reduction of the assessment basis in cases where the contra is a sum of money but to exclude such reductions in other cases. - Opinion C-41/96 SYD-Consult: competition. Request for preliminary ruling. Interpretation of EC treaty article 85 and of Commission regulation 123/85 of December 12, 1984, on the application of article 85, paragraph 3 of the EC treaty to automotive distribution, sales and after sales service contracts. National legislation on unfair competition requiring a tight system so that its members may obtain injunctions banning third parties from the distribution of the products in question. Distinction between distribution systems that are tight in theory, and those that are tight in theory and in practice. - Opinion C-114/96 Kieffer: free movement of goods. Request for preliminary ruling. Validity of Council regulation 3330/91 of November 7, 1991, on trade statistics between member states. Interpretation of EC treaty articles 30 and 36. Interpretation of article 3B, line 3, as encompassed by article G, point 5 of the Maastricht treaty. Proportionality principle as it concerns a national law applying penal sanctions to a refusal to furnish information required in application of the INTRASTAT data gathering system. - Oral procedure C-259/95 Parliament v/ Council: environment and consumers. Annulment of Council decision 95/184 of May 22, 1995, amending decision 3092/94 on a Community system of information on domestic accidents and leisure. Unilateral amendment by the Council on the basis of article 169 of the Membership Act of 1994, of a decision taken by the EU parliament and the Council according to the procedure in article 189B of EC treaty (co-decision). - (1115/1215 GMT) Oral procedure C-60/96 Commission v/ France: taxation. Non-respect. Breach of article 2 of sixth Council VAT directive 77/388/EEC of May 17, 1977, on the harmonisation of member states' legislation on turnover tax. Common VAT system: uniform basis of assessment. Granting of VAT exoneration on the rental of certain furnished goods such as tents, trailers, mobile homes, etc.

COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, THIRD CHAMBER (enlarged) (0930/0830 GMT) - Judgment T-106/95 FFSA v/ Commission: state aid. Annulment of Commission decision of February 21, 1995, concluding that the tax advantages that benefit the French postal service in its competitive activities do not constitute state aid within the meaning of article 92 of the EC treaty.

PRESIDENT (0930/0830 GMT) - Interim ruling T-79/96 Camar v/ Commission: agriculture. Action for incompetence with a view to having it acknowledged that the Commission illegally abstained from taking measures on the basis of article 30 of regulation 404/93 that would have allowed the claimant to take supplies of bananas from Somalia despite the war in that country. Action for compensation for damages allegedly caused by the conduct of the Commission.
COURT OF JUSTICE, PLENARY COURT (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-189/95 Franzen: free movement of goods. - Opinion C-334/95 Krueger: agriculture. - Oral procedure C-296/95 EMU tabac: taxation.
COURT OF JUSTICE, SIXTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-398/95 Syndesmos ton en Elladi Touristikon: free movement of persons.
COURT OF FIRST INSTANCE, FOURTH CHAMBER (enlarged) (0915/0815 GMT) - Judgment T-105/95 WWF UK v/ Commission: insitutional law.
COURT OF JUSTICE, FIRST CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-405/95 Bioforce: free movement of goods.
FIFTH CHAMBER (0930/0830 GMT) - Opinion C-26/96 Rotexchemie: trade policy.
